description: `--config alt.json` overrides the default `serve.json` lookup. The fixture ships both: `serve.json` sets `public: default-dir` (with `default-dir/index.html` saying `default`); `alt.json` sets `public: site` (with `site/index.html` saying `site`). With `--config alt.json`, the alternate file wins and `GET /` serves the `site` content. Backs SRV-CLI-009 and SRV-CFG-001 (explicit-overrides-default scenario, observable through `public`).
